Chiefs vs Bills DraftKings Showdown Picks: Thursday Night Football NFL DFS Captains, Projections and Sim Plays

DraftKings Showdown · Thursday Night Football, November 26 · NFL Week 12 · By Chris Spags · · Numbers as of November 25, 3:39 PM ET

Josh Allen has the highest SPAGS projection in the Chiefs at Bills DraftKings Showdown: 20.6 points at $11,000 FLEX, 30.9 at captain for $16,500. In a game totaled at 46.5, the model's favorite play is the quarterback who also runs. It has him carrying 6.2 times, and across 50,000 simulations he holds 70% of the winning-lineup credit.

Emmett Johnson has the largest captain share: 23.9% of the simulated winning-lineup credit comes with Johnson at captain. The model gives him 12.3 carries and 2.9 targets. Josh Allen is the next captain in line, at 16.2%. The model has him running 6.2 times.

Buffalo is a 3-point favorite, and the implied totals are 24.75 for the Bills and 21.75 for the Chiefs.

Behind Allen and Johnson, the next projections are Patrick Mahomes (17.8, $10,000), James Cook III (17.8, $9,800) and Travis Kelce (12.0, $7,800).

Every projection below is a SPAGS model estimate from the November 25, 3:39 PM ET run of the Splash Play NFL model. Winning-lineup and captain credit come from 50,000 simulations of the Showdown contest, and tied winning entries share credit. A player's simulated floor is his 10th-percentile score and his ceiling is his 95th. Showdown lineups use one captain, who scores 1.5x at 1.5x salary, and five FLEX players.

TNF Showdown captain picks: who the sim wins with

Captain: Emmett Johnson, KC RB ($9,400 FLEX / $14,100 CPT)

Emmett Johnson holds 23.9% of the simulated winning-lineup credit as a captain, more than any other player in this game. At captain he costs $14,100 and the 19.9-point SPAGS model projection becomes 29.8 with the 1.5x captain multiplier. The model gives him 12.3 carries and 2.9 targets. Across 50,000 simulations Johnson averaged 19.9 points with a simulated floor of 8.0 and a ceiling of 36.9. He holds 69% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 23.9% as the captain and 45.6% in a FLEX spot.

Captain: Josh Allen, BUF QB ($11,000 FLEX / $16,500 CPT)

Josh Allen holds 16.2% of the simulated winning-lineup credit as a captain. At captain he costs $16,500 and the 20.6-point SPAGS model projection becomes 30.9 with the 1.5x captain multiplier. The model includes 6.2 rushing attempts. Across 50,000 simulations Allen averaged 20.6 points with a simulated floor of 11.8 and a ceiling of 39.7. He holds 70% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 16.2% as the captain and 53.8% in a FLEX spot.

Captain: James Cook III, BUF RB ($9,800 FLEX / $14,700 CPT)

James Cook III holds 15.7% of the simulated winning-lineup credit as a captain. At captain he costs $14,700 and the 17.8-point SPAGS model projection becomes 26.7 with the 1.5x captain multiplier. The model gives him 20.7 carries and 2.1 targets. Across 50,000 simulations Cook averaged 17.8 points with a simulated floor of 6.3 and a ceiling of 35.4. He holds 57% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 15.7% as the captain and 41.0% in a FLEX spot.

Patrick Mahomes, KC QB ($10,000 FLEX / $15,000 CPT)

He holds 59% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 10.0% as the captain and 49.0% in a FLEX spot.

Travis Kelce, KC TE ($7,800 FLEX / $11,700 CPT)

Travis Kelce carries the 5th-highest SPAGS model projection in the game at 12.0 DraftKings points for a $7,800 FLEX salary ($11,700 at captain). The model gives him 6.3 targets on 26.0 routes. Across 50,000 simulations Kelce averaged 12.0 points with a simulated floor of 2.4 and a ceiling of 26.7. Across 50,000 simulations Rice averaged 10.8 points with a simulated floor of 2.4 and a ceiling of 25.7. He holds 25% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 4.5% as the captain and 20.5% in a FLEX spot.

Showdown value plays at $5,000 and under

Value: Keon Coleman, BUF WR ($3,800 FLEX / $5,700 CPT)

Keon Coleman projects for 6.6 DraftKings points at a $3,800 FLEX salary, 1.73 projected points per $1,000. The model gives him 3.1 targets on 15.7 routes. Across 50,000 simulations Coleman averaged 6.6 points with a simulated floor of -0.2 and a ceiling of 18.8. He holds 21% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 2.3% as the captain and 18.9% in a FLEX spot.

Value: Tyler Bass, BUF K ($5,000 FLEX / $7,500 CPT)

Tyler Bass projects for 8.6 DraftKings points at a $5,000 FLEX salary, 1.72 projected points per $1,000. Across 50,000 simulations Bass averaged 8.6 points with a simulated floor of 1.5 and a ceiling of 16.5. He holds 29% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 0.9% as the captain and 28.5% in a FLEX spot.

Chiefs vs Bills DraftKings Showdown FAQ

Who is the best captain for the Chiefs vs Bills DraftKings Showdown?

Emmett Johnson holds the largest captain share of simulated winning lineups at 23.9%, ahead of Josh Allen (16.2%) and James Cook III (15.7%), across 50,000 simulations.

What is the best DraftKings Showdown lineup for Chiefs vs Bills?

Build around Emmett Johnson at captain with Josh Allen, James Cook III and Dalton Kincaid at FLEX. That is the core of the lineup that won the most simulations in Chris Spags' pool (70 of 50,000 simulated contests), and it leaves $8,900 for the last two FLEX spots.

Who has the highest projection in Chiefs vs Bills DraftKings Showdown?

Josh Allen leads the SPAGS model at 20.6 DraftKings points for $11,000 at FLEX, or 30.9 points at captain for $16,500.

What are the DraftKings salaries for Chiefs vs Bills Showdown?

Josh Allen is the most expensive player at $11,000 FLEX and $16,500 at captain. All 31 players with a SPAGS projection are listed above with FLEX salary, captain salary and projection.

At $5,000 and under, the best projected points per $1,000 belong to Keon Coleman (6.6 points at $3,800), Tyler Bass (8.6 points at $5,000) and Harrison Butker (7.9 points at $4,800).

What is the Chiefs vs Bills spread and total?

The Bills are a 3-point favorite in a game totaled at 46.5, with implied team totals of 24.75 for the Bills and 21.75 for the Chiefs.
